diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a moderate downward trend (a net fall of ~67% of its level). Seasonality is strong (period 24): a repeating cycle explains much of the movement. The series is quite predictable: its energy concentrates in a few structured frequencies. The series reads as ambiguous by the ADF/KPSS tests. A few outliers stand out (791 points, ~5% of the sample). The series crosses zero, so percentage errors are unstable and mean-based combinations are safer than ratio-based ones. Across validation windows the model ranking is moderate (Kendall tau 0.626), which favours a selective combination.
